description: This file contains functions and constants for migrating, normalizing, and resolving legacy web search configurations within a larger application. It handles configuration paths, plugin data, and migration logic for web search providers.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a JsonRecord object.

methods.name: cloneRecord
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of a JsonRecord.

methods.name: ensureRecord
methods.description: Ensures a target object has a specific key with a JsonRecord value, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: resolveLegacySearchConfig
methods.description: Extracts the legacy search configuration object from raw input.

methods.name: copyLegacyProviderConfig
methods.description: Copies the configuration for a specific legacy provider key.

methods.name: hasOwnKey
methods.description: Checks if a target object has a specific own property key.

methods.name: hasMappedLegacyWebSearchConfig
methods.description: Determines if the raw config has a mapped legacy web search configuration.

methods.name: resolveLegacyGlobalWebSearchMigration
methods.description: Resolves migration details for the global web search provider if applicable.

methods.name: migratePluginWebSearchConfig
methods.description: Migrates plugin web search configuration into the main config structure.

methods.name: listLegacyWebSearchConfigPaths
methods.description: Lists all configuration paths related to legacy web search settings.

methods.name: normalizeLegacyWebSearchConfig
methods.description: Normalizes the legacy web search configuration, removing deprecated fields.

methods.name: migrateLegacyWebSearchConfig
methods.description: Performs migration of legacy web search config, returning changes made.

methods.name: normalizeLegacyWebSearchConfigRecord
methods.description: Helper to normalize the config record and track changes.

methods.name: resolvePluginWebSearchConfig
methods.description: Resolves the web search configuration for a specific plugin from the main config.
